title: おおきくなっているよ (Ookiku Natte Iru yo)
description: Yuu gets measured at the school health checkup and discovers they are 3cm taller than last year. This sparks a warm journey of noticing growth — lost teeth, new skills, and looking through a photo album with grandparent. A gentle story about how growing happens slowly, without you noticing.
author: オリジナル
